name: zsnd_stream_mgr_shutdown
description: zSndStreamMgr::Shutdown removes stream root state, drains active/free request lists, frees pending group stream-entry blocks, clears root/list globals, and returns 1.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja reconstruction is limited around the pending group block-byte offset loop, but assembly and source agree on 0x18-byte zSndGroupConfigBlock traversal and child stream-entry cleanup.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a50a0 validates optional root node action callback clearing/deletion when zClass is initialized, active-list drain/free/destroy, free-list drain/free/destroy, pending-list drain, kind-1 pending config block traversal, child stream-entry linked-list free at block offset +0x14, block/config free, pending-list destroy, root/list global clears, and return 1.
The native smoke verifies the active, free, and pending list teardown behavior and that the matched-request scan globals are not cleared by Shutdown.
